name: Moon Observatory Parilyne
source:
Parilyne is a completely normal girl except for the fact that she's a singularity--a mathematical anomaly in that there's only one of her despite the infinite parallel universes.

This paradoxical existence marks her for deletion--until Nova, the November Magician, decides to step in to break this cycle.

Pulled along by Magicians helping her and Magicians hunting her down, she'll have to decide for herself just how strong her will to live is.

[From [url=https://moonobservatory.uwu.ai/#upcoming]official website[/url]]
